identifier_sources.gbif: api.gbif.org/v1/species/{key} (accepted usage looked up by key)
identifier_sources.ncbi: eutils esearch db=taxonomy + esummary (rank and name checked)
identifier_sources.wikidata: wbsearchentities + wbgetentities; item chosen whose P225 taxon name / P846 GBIF id matches
identifier_sources.itis: TSN from Wikidata P815, verified with ITIS getScientificNameFromTSN
identifier_sources.worms: no WoRMS statement on the Wikidata item

notes: GBIF treats Mustela furo Linnaeus, 1758 (usageKey 5816581) as a synonym of the accepted subspecies Mustela putorius furo (5218913); the accepted usage is recorded. Wikidata item Q178973 (ferret) carries P225 'Mustela furo'. Trait databases list only the species Mustela putorius.
